blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Hydrocarbons) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab diye gaye hain. Structures (Q.2 k, l) condensed formulas mein likhe gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
I. An alkene undergoes ozonolysis followed by reduction with zinc dust and water to yield propanone and methanal. The alkene is:
(Aik alkene ozonolysis aur phir Zn/H₂O se propanone aur methanal deti hai. Alkene kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ozonolysis C=C ko kaat kar har carbon par C=O lagati hai (11.8.1). Dono carbonyl carbons ko wapas jorne se: (CH₃)₂C=O + O=CH₂ = (CH₃)₂C=CH₂, yani 2-methylpropene.
(CH₃)₂C=CH₂ + O₃ → ozonide → (Zn/H₂O) (CH₃)₂C=O + HCHO

blocks.prompt:
II. Which of the following reagents is typically used for the acid-catalyzed hydration of alkenes to form alcohols?
(Alkenes se alcohol banane wali acid-catalyzed hydration mein kaun sa reagent istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydration mein acid (H₂SO₄) catalyst ki madad se C=C par H₂O judta hai: CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → (H₂SO₄) C₂H₅OH (11.8.1). H₂/Ni hydrogenation, O₃ cleavage aur Br₂ bromination karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Halogenation of alkanes is an example of:
(Alkanes ki halogenation kis qism ki reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes UV roshni mein Cl₂ ya Br₂ se free radicals ke zariye reaction karti hain (initiation, propagation, termination) aur H ki jagah halogen aata hai (11.5.1).

blocks.prompt:
IV. Which of the following reactions can an alkane undergo?
(Alkane kaun si reaction kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes saturated hain (π bond nahi), is liye addition ya polymerization nahi karti; yeh free radical substitution (aur combustion, cracking) karti hain (11.5).

blocks.prompt:
V. What is the first step in the electrophilic addition reaction of alkenes?
(Alkenes ki electrophilic addition ka pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: Double bond par electrophile ka hamla

blocks.explanation: Pehle C=C ke π electrons electrophile par hamla karte hain; is se carbocation banta hai jis par phir nucleophile hamla karta hai (11.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
VI. The addition of unsymmetrical reagent to an unsymmetrical alkene is in accordance with the rule/principle?
(Ghair-mutanasib (unsymmetrical) reagent ka unsymmetrical alkene se judna kis usool ke mutabiq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Markovnikov ka usool: reagent ka negative hissa us double bond wale carbon se judta hai jis par kam hydrogen hon (11.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
VII. The most stable carbonium ion among the following is:
(In mein sab se mustahkam (stable) carbonium ion (carbocation) kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbonium ion carbocation ka purana naam hai. (CH₃)₃C⁺ tertiary hai: teen alkyl groups C⁺ ki taraf electrons dhakelte hain (+I effect), is liye stability 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl (11.7.2).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Markownikov’s rule is applicable to :
(Markovnikov ka usool kis par lagu hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh usool sirf unsymmetrical alkene par lagta hai. (CH₃)₂C=CH₂ unsymmetrical hai; ethene aur 2-butene symmetrical hain aur propane (b) mein double bond hi nahi (11.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
IX. What intermediate is formed during the electrophilic addition of HBr to an alkene?
(Alkene par HBr ki electrophilic addition mein kaun sa darmiyani (intermediate) banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: HBr ka H⁺ C=C ke aik carbon se judta hai aur carbocation banta hai, jis par phir Br⁻ hamla karta hai (11.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
X. The enhanced stability of conjugated dienes compared to isolated dienes is primarily attributed to:
(Conjugated dienes isolated dienes se zyada stable kyun hain?)

options.text: Conjugated system mein π electrons ka phailao (delocalisation)
Double bonds ke darmiyan steric rukawat

blocks.explanation: Conjugated diene mein saath wale carbons ke p orbitals overlap karte hain, is liye π electrons poore system par phail jate hain (delocalisation) aur molecule stable hota hai (11.9).

blocks.prompt:
XI. Which of the following carbocations would be the least stable?
(Kaun sa carbocation sab se kam stable hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methyl carbocation CH₃⁺ par koi alkyl group nahi jo positive carbon ko electrons de (+I), is liye yeh sab se kam stable hai (11.7.2).

blocks.prompt:
XII. Which of the following is the repeating unit in the polymer poly(ethene) (polyethylene)?
(Poly(ethene) ka repeating unit kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Repeating unit monomer CH₂=CH₂ hi hai, bas C=C single bond ban jata hai: −CH₂−CH₂− (11.8.1). (d) poly(propene) ka unit hai.

blocks.prompt:
XIII. Which type of structural isomerism involves differences in the arrangement of the carbon skeleton?
(Kaun si structural isomerism carbon dhanche (skeleton) ki tarteeb ke farq se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chain isomerism carbon chain ke farq se hoti hai, misal butane aur 2-methylpropane (C₄H₁₀) (11.10.1).

blocks.prompt:
a. Define the following:
i) Cycloalkanes ii) Isomerism iii) Conjugated dienes iv) Inductive effect
In ki tareef likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Cycloalkanes: saturated cyclic aliphatic hydrocarbons (CₙH₂ₙ) jin ke carbon atoms single bonds se ring banate hain, misal cyclopropane C₃H₆.
ii) Isomerism: do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik ho lekin structural formula aur properties mukhtalif hon, misal butane aur 2-methylpropane.
iii) Conjugated dienes: woh dienes jin ke do C=C double bonds ke beech sirf aik single bond ho, misal CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂.
iv) Inductive effect: saath wale atoms ya groups ke electrons kheenchne (−I, misal halogen) ya dhakelne (+I, misal alkyl) se σ bond ka polarize hona.

blocks.prompt:
b. Differentiate between:
i) Aliphatic and Aromatic hydrocarbons
Aliphatic aur aromatic hydrocarbons mein farq likhein.
blocks.explanation: Aromatic hydrocarbons benzene ring par mabni hain; baqi sab aliphatic hain.

Benzene (C₆H₆) ya us jaisi rings par mabni

Misal benzene, toluene

blocks.prompt:
b. ii) Homolytic and Heterolytic Fission
Homolytic aur heterolytic fission mein farq likhein.
blocks.explanation: Dono covalent bond torte hain; farq yeh hai ke shared electron pair kaise bat-ta hai.

Misal H–Br → H⁺ + Br⁻

blocks.prompt:
b. iii) Electrophile and Nucleophile
Electrophile aur nucleophile mein farq likhein.
blocks.explanation: Electrophile electrons dhoondta hai; nucleophile electrons deta hai.

rows: Electron pair lene wala (electron pasand)
Electron pair dene wala
Positive ya electron ki kami wala, E⁺
Negative ya lone pair/π electrons wala, Nu:⁻

blocks.prompt:
c. Explain why alkanes do not undergo addition reactions.
Alkanes addition reactions kyun nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: Alkanes saturated hain: har carbon ke paas pehle se chaar single σ bonds hain aur todne ke liye koi π bond nahi, is liye koi atom mazeed nahi jud sakta. Yeh sirf H ko hata kar (substitution) reaction karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
d. How elimination reaction is considered the opposite of an addition reaction.
Elimination reaction ko addition ka ulat kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Addition mein C=C par atoms judte hain aur alkene saturated ho jati hai; elimination mein saath wale carbons se chhota molecule nikalta hai aur C=C banta hai. Aik doosre ka ulat hai.

rows: C=C par atoms ya groups judte hain
Saath wale carbons se chhota molecule (H₂O, HX) nikalta hai
π bond toot-ta hai; unsaturated → saturated
π bond banta hai; saturated → unsaturated
Misal CH₂=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃CH₂Br
Misal CH₃CH₂Br + KOH(alc) → CH₂=CH₂ + KBr + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
e. Compare the carbocation stability in propene and 2-butene.
Propene aur 2-butene se banne wale carbocations ki stability ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Propene (unsymmetrical) 2° carbocation CH₃CH⁺CH₃ (zyada stable, do +I methyl groups) ya 1° carbocation CH₃CH₂CH₂⁺ (kam stable) de sakti hai; is liye major aur minor do products bante hain.
2-Butene (symmetrical) kisi bhi carbon par hamle se aik hi 2° carbocation CH₃CH⁺CH₂CH₃ deti hai, is liye sirf aik product banta hai. Dono ke asal carbocations secondary hain aur taqreeban barabar stable.

blocks.prompt:
f. Given the molecular formula C₅H₁₀, list all possible structural isomers that are alkenes.
C₅H₁₀ ke tamam alkene structural isomers likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Paanch alkene structural isomers:
1. CH₂=CH–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃, pent-1-ene
2. CH₃–CH=CH–CH₂–CH₃, pent-2-ene
3. CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃, 2-methylbut-1-ene
4. CH₂=CH–CH(CH₃)–CH₃, 3-methylbut-1-ene
5. (CH₃)₂C=CH–CH₃, 2-methylbut-2-ene
(Pent-2-ene ki cis aur trans shakalein bhi hain; yeh stereoisomerism Class 12 mein hai.)

blocks.prompt:
g. When propene (C₃H₆) undergoes electrophilic addition with HBr, it forms 2-bromopropane as the major product. Explain why 2-bromopropane is favored over 1-bromopropane, using the concept of carbocation stability.
Propene par HBr ki addition se 2-bromopropane major product kyun banta hai? Carbocation stability se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: H⁺ C=C ke kisi bhi carbon se jud sakta hai. CH₂ wale sire par judne se 2° carbocation CH₃CH⁺CH₃ banta hai jise do methyl groups ka +I effect stable karta hai; darmiyani carbon par judne se kam stable 1° carbocation CH₃CH₂CH₂⁺ banta hai. Zyada stable 2° ion jaldi banta hai aur Br⁻ us par hamla karke 2-bromopropane deta hai (Markovnikov ka usool).

blocks.prompt:
h. Explain why conjugated alkenes may show different reactivity compared to isolated alkenes.
Conjugated alkenes isolated alkenes se mukhtalif reactivity kyun dikhati hain?
blocks.explanation: Conjugated alkenes mein saath wale carbons ke p orbitals overlap karte hain aur π electrons poore system par phail jate hain (delocalise). Is se yeh zyada stable hoti hain aur in ki reactions badal jati hain, misal buta-1,3-diene polymerize ho kar rubber jaise polymers deti hai. Isolated alkenes mein har C=C alag simple alkene ki tarah reaction karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
i. Explain how inductive effects from alkyl groups stabilize carbocations in alkenes.
Alkyl groups ka inductive effect carbocations ko kaise stable karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Alkyl groups electrons dhakelte hain (+I). Yeh σ bond ke electrons positive carbon ki taraf dhakel kar us ka positive charge kam (phaila) dete hain, jis se ion zyada stable hota hai. Jitne zyada alkyl groups, utna zyada stable: 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl carbocation.

blocks.prompt:
j. Write the equation for each reaction.
i. CH₃CH₂CH=CH₂ with H₂ (Ni catalyst)
ii. CH₃CH=CH₂ with Cl₂
iii. CH₃CH₂CH=CHCH₂CH₃ with H₂O (H₂SO₄ catalyst)
Har reaction ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i. CH₃CH₂CH=CH₂ + H₂ → (Ni, garmi) CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ (butane)
ii. CH₃CH=CH₂ + Cl₂ → CH₃CHClCH₂Cl (1,2-dichloropropane)
iii. CH₃CH₂CH=CHCH₂CH₃ + H₂O → (H₂SO₄) CH₃CH₂CH(OH)CH₂CH₂CH₃ (hexan-3-ol)

blocks.text: Naam x) 'But-1 -en.3 -yne' chhapa hai; sahi But-1-en-3-yne (CH₂=CH–C≡CH) hai.

blocks.text: Naam se formula banane ka tareeqa: (1) naam ke aakhir wala hissa (hex-, pent-) chain ki lambai batata hai; (2) -ene/-yne ke number double/triple bond ki jagah; (3) shuru ke numbers (2,3-dimethyl) branches ki jagah. Aakhir mein har carbon ki chaar bonds poori karne ke liye H lagayein.

blocks.title: Wazahat

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Describe the free radical halogenation of methane using Cl₂ as an example.
Methane ki Cl₂ se free radical halogenation bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Methane dhoop ya UV roshni mein chlorine se reaction karti hai; free radicals ke zariye H ki jagah Cl aata hai: CH₄ + Cl₂ → (UV) CH₃Cl + HCl.
Mechanism:
1. Initiation: UV roshni Cl–Cl bond ko barabar (homolytic) torti hai: Cl₂ → (hν) Cl• + Cl•
2. Propagation: CH₄ + Cl• → •CH₃ + HCl; phir •CH₃ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl•. Naya Cl• cycle dohrata hai (chain reaction).
3. Termination: do radicals mil jate hain: •CH₃ + Cl• → CH₃Cl; •CH₃ + •CH₃ → CH₃–CH₃ (ethane ke nishan, free radicals ka saboot); Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂.
Mazeed substitution: zyada chlorine se propagation dohrata hai: CH₃Cl → CH₂Cl₂ (dichloromethane) → CHCl₃ (trichloromethane, chloroform) → CCl₄ (tetrachloromethane). Shuru mein jitni zyada Cl₂, utne zyada chlorine wale products.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 Describe the following methods for the preparation of alkenes:
i) Dehydrohalogenation of alkyl halides
ii) Dehydration of alcohols
Alkenes banane ke yeh tareeqe bayan karein: dehydrohalogenation aur dehydration.
blocks.explanation:
Dono elimination reactions hain: saath wale carbon atoms se chhota molecule nikalta hai aur C=C double bond banta hai.
i) Alkyl halides ki dehydrohalogenation: alkyl halide ko alcoholic KOH ke saath garam kiya jata hai; saath wale carbons se H aur halogen HX ki soorat nikalte hain.
H₃C–CH₂–Br + KOH(alcoholic) → (garmi) H₂C=CH₂ + KBr + H₂O
ii) Alcohols ki dehydration: ethanol ko zyada concentrated H₂SO₄ ke saath 180 °C par garam karne se pani ka molecule nikalta hai.
CH₃CH₂OH → (conc. H₂SO₄, 180 °C) CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O
Yeh ethyl hydrogen sulphate ke zariye do qadam mein hoti hai:
CH₃CH₂OH + H₂SO₄ → CH₃CH₂OSO₃H + H₂O
CH₃CH₂OSO₃H → (garmi) H₂C=CH₂ + H₂SO₄ (acid wapas mil jata hai).

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Describe the mechanism of electrophilic addition of hydrogen halides to alkenes. Discuss Markovnikov’s Rule in the context of hydrogen halide addition.
Alkenes par hydrogen halides ki electrophilic addition ka mechanism bayan karein. Is mein Markovnikov ka usool samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Alkenes room temperature par khushk (dry) hydrogen halides se haloalkanes banati hain; raftaar HF < HCl < HBr < HI. H–X polar hai (Hδ⁺–Xδ⁻), is liye H electrophile hai.
Mechanism (ethene + HBr):
Qadam 1: C=C ke π electrons HBr ke δ⁺ H par hamla karte hain; H–Br heterolytic toot kar Br⁻ deta hai aur carbocation banta hai: CH₂=CH₂ + H–Br → CH₃–CH₂⁺ + Br⁻
Qadam 2: nucleophile Br⁻ carbocation par hamla karta hai: CH₃–CH₂⁺ + Br⁻ → CH₃–CH₂–Br (bromoethane)
Symmetrical alkene se sirf aik product banta hai.
Markovnikov ka usool: jab polar reagent unsymmetrical alkene se judta hai to reagent ka negative hissa us double bond wale carbon se judta hai jis par kam hydrogen hon.
Propene + HBr: H⁺ CH₂ wale sire se judta hai aur zyada stable 2° carbocation CH₃–CH⁺–CH₃ banta hai (do +I methyl groups); Br⁻ is par hamla karke 2-bromopropane (major) deta hai. Kam stable 1° carbocation CH₃CH₂CH₂⁺ se 1-bromopropane (minor) banta hai.
CH₃–CH=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CHBr–CH₃ (major) + CH₃–CH₂–CH₂Br (minor)

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Explain the following reactions of alkenes with examples:
a) Halogenation b) Ozonolysis
c) Epoxidation d) Polymerization
Alkenes ki yeh reactions misalon ke saath samjhayein: halogenation, ozonolysis, epoxidation, polymerization.
blocks.explanation:
a) Halogenation: C=C par Cl₂ ya Br₂ ka judna. CCl₄ mein bromine (surkhi mayel bhoora rang) ethene se foran be-rang ho jati hai, jo unsaturation ka test hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + Br₂ → Br–CH₂–CH₂–Br (1,2-dibromoethane)
Mechanism: C=C Br–Br ke electrons ko door dhakelta hai, qareeb wala Br δ⁺ (electrophile) ban jata hai; π electrons us par hamla karte hain, carbocation aur Br⁻ bante hain; phir Br⁻ carbocation par hamla karta hai.
b) Ozonolysis: ozone C=C ko kaat kar ozonide banati hai, jise Zn/H₂O carbonyl compounds (aldehydes ya ketones) mein badal deta hai.
C₂H₄ + O₃ → C₂H₄O₃ (ozonide) → (Zn/H₂O) 2HCHO
CH₃CH=CH₂ + O₃ → ozonide → (Zn/H₂O) CH₃CHO + HCHO
Carbonyl products batate hain ke double bond kahan tha, is liye anjaan alkene ki banawat maloom karne mein kaam aati hai.
c) Epoxidation: oxidizing agent C=C par aik O atom jorta hai aur epoxide (teen kone wala cyclic ether) banta hai. Ethene silver catalyst par O₂ se ethylene oxide deti hai; acid hydrolysis se yeh ethane-1,2-diol banta hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + ½O₂ → (Ag) ethylene oxide (CH₂–CH₂ ring O ke saath) → (H⁺/H₂O) HOCH₂–CH₂OH
d) Polymerization (addition): C=C wale bohat se monomers jud kar lambi chain banate hain (sirf aik product); har π bond toot-ta hai aur naye C–C single bonds bante hain.
n CH₂=CH₂ → –[CH₂–CH₂]ₙ– (poly(ethene))
n CH₂=CHCl → –[CH₂–CHCl]ₙ– (PVC)
Thailiyon, botlon, packing aur pipes mein istemal.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ozonolysis se double bond ki jagah dhoondne ka tareeqa: dono carbonyl products ke C=O wale carbons ko 'O' hata kar aapas mein double bond se jor dein; jo alkene banti hai wahi asal alkene thi.

items: MCQs ke jawab: I c, II c, III c, IV b, V c, VI a, VII d, VIII d, IX a, X c, XI c, XII c, XIII a.
C₅H₁₀ ke paanch alkene isomers: pent-1-ene, pent-2-ene, 2-methylbut-1-ene, 3-methylbut-1-ene, 2-methylbut-2-ene.
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: Q.2(k)(x) 'But-1 -en.3 -yne' (But-1-en-3-yne), Q.2(l) ke labels gadbad aur dohraye hue.
